verdict.summary: The round-1 findings are resolved. Totals are now accepted only when they are non-negative integers greater than the displayed slice length, and the executed browser fixture covers fractional values across all six seams. The health-card gate now accounts for lane/defer/exit rows and valid truncation states independently, so an empty lane slice with a positive total renders `showing 0 of 50 lanes` without suppressing sibling defer/exit content. Generator totals are computed from validated pre-cap rows, emitted unconditionally, and pinned by literal over-cap and under-cap expectations. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
